table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,  
	manf=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	itemdescription=quotationdetail.itemdescription,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
	 custphone= dbo.customer.phone, 
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,   
	headerno = dbo.quotationheader.headerno,   
	date = dbo.quotationheader.date,   

	deliverydays = dbo.quotationheader.deliverydays,   
	validitydays = dbo.quotationheader.validitydays,   
	paymentto = dbo.quotationheader.paymentto,   


	invdiscperc = dbo.quotationheader.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.quotationheader.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.quotationheader.salestax,   
	icode = quotationdetail.icode,   
	
	looseqty = quotationdetail.qty,   
	color = quotationdetail.color,   
	bonusqty = quotationdetail.bonusqty,   
	 
	packunits= quotationdetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= quotationdetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = quotationdetail.discperc,   
	salestax = quotationdetail.salestax,   
	Id = dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=quotationheader.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = quotationdetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = quotationdetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = quotationheader.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.quotationheader.custrefno,	
	dbo.quotationheader.remarks,
	remarks2=quotationheader.remarks2,
	remarks3=quotationheader.remarks3,
	remarks4=quotationheader.remarks4,
	remarks5=quotationheader.remarks5
FROM 
	quotationheader,   
	quotationdetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = :ar_invcode ) AND  
	( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode) AND  
	( dbo.quotationheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.quotationheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.quotationdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
ORDER BY 
	dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: c_itemnettotal
objects.expression: (  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  +round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_itemtotal
objects.expression: sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  +round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)
